```{r}
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "summary", "hazardResults.R"))
```

En roca de referencia ($V_{S30}=760$ m/s), la PGA media alcanza `r .fmt(HazardSummary$pga[Vs30 == 760 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g para $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]])`$ años y `r .fmt(HazardSummary$pga[Vs30 == 760 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g para $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]])`$ años; los máximos de la UHS media son `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g en `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", Tn], 2)` s y `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g en `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", Tn], 2)` s, respectivamente. La salida en roca reporta la media; los fractiles de $V_{S30}=800$ m/s corresponden a esa condición de sitio.

Los escenarios modales de desagregación son $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], Mw], 1)` a `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], R])` km y $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], Mw], 1)` a `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], R])` km para PGA, y $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], Mw], 1)` a `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], R])` km y $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], Mw], 1)` a `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], R])` km para $S_a(1.0\,\mathrm{s})$, en `r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]])` y `r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]])` años.

Las mayores contribuciones por fuente corresponden a `r paste(HazardSummary$source[Tn == Tn.PGA, sprintf("%s (%s años)", sourceDisplay, .fmti(TR))], collapse = " y ")` para PGA y a `r paste(HazardSummary$source[Tn == 1, sprintf("%s (%s años)", sourceDisplay, .fmti(TR))], collapse = " y ")` para $S_a(1.0\,\mathrm{s})$.
